body.intent: The daemon keeps the Go build cache and stale build temp folders from filling the disk: on 2026-11-05 the VM's ~/.cache/go-build reached 47G and ~/tmp held stale go-build* folders from killed builds (disk 19G free of 97G) after one evening of runs; Go only trims entries unused for 5 days. When free space nears rhiza.daemon.minFree (or on a schedule), the daemon trims go-build entries untouched for a few hours (mtime, which go refreshes on use) and removes go-build* temp folders older than a couple of hours, logging what it freed; a test with a fake cache dir shows only stale entries go.
